bio.text: Mike Gipson represents California's 65th Assembly District, which includes Watts, Willowbrook, Compton, Carson, North Long Beach and San Pedro; he has served in the Assembly since 2014.
He was born and raised in the Watts community of Los Angeles and was elected to the Carson City Council in 2005, serving as Mayor Pro Tempore.
Gipson was Assembly Democratic Caucus Chair from 2015 until July 2023 and now chairs the Revenue and Taxation Committee.
